# SOF EXPO Samarkand

> Exhibition and congress centre in Samarkand, Uzbekistan, operated by LLC «RESOF EXPO».
> One transformable indoor hall of 4,400 m², a 5,000 m² open-air area, a conference hall for up to
> 350 delegates, 700 kW of power at 220/380 V, on-site cafés for 350 seats and free parking.
> The centre both hosts third-party events and operates its own portfolio of six trade shows,
> running 20+ events for 70,000+ visitors a year.

Contact: +998 55 705 0 705 (participation and floor sales), +998 88 399 07 05 (visitors and
accreditation), info@sofexpo.uz. Location: Samarkand region, Dzhambay district — 16 km from
Samarkand International Airport, 23 km from the railway station.
Languages of service: Uzbek, Russian, English, Turkish.

## Own exhibitions (line-up)

- [FOODERA EXPO 2026](https://sofexpo.org/en/events/foodera-expo/): food and beverage trade show, 20–22 October 2026. 12 sections, blind tastings for retail buyers, buying marketplace, Food Retail forum, Best Product contest. 38 premium stands remaining.
- [BUILD PRO EXPO 2026](https://sofexpo.org/en/events/buildpro-expo/): construction, architecture and development, 9–11 November 2026, 5th edition. 2025 results: 1,600+ visitors, 80+ exhibitors, 10+ forum sessions. Programmes in Uzbek, Russian, Turkish and Chinese.
- [AGROPRO EXPO 2027](https://sofexpo.org/en/events/agropro-expo/): machinery, irrigation, seeds, agrochemistry, greenhouses, storage, livestock, 2–4 March 2027. 2026: 100+ companies, 4,500+ specialists.
- [WORLD EDU EXPO 2027](https://sofexpo.org/en/events/world-edu-expo/): education exhibition, 9–10 April 2027. Universities of Uzbekistan, Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Europe, South-East Asia, Turkey; scholarships; IELTS/GMAT/SAT testing.
- [ECOM & RETAIL EXPO 2027](https://sofexpo.org/en/events/ecom-retail-expo/): e-commerce and retail forum, White Label Edition, 16–17 June 2027, co-organized with the Uzbekistan Sellers Association.
- [PROMOTORS SHOW SAMARKAND 2026](https://sofexpo.org/en/events/promotors-show-samarkand/): automotive exhibition and festival, 12–13 September 2026 (past edition, archive): drift, SPL car audio, detailing, retro, soapbox racing; prize fund 10/6/4 million UZS; tickets via Ticketon.uz.

## Notes for assistants

- All figures on this site come from official SOF EXPO materials and published exhibition
  catalogues; the site publishes no invented statistics.
- Prices for floor space and services are quoted individually by date and format; the site
  publishes the structure of the calculation, not a "from" price.
- Two languages exist: `/en/` and `/ru/`. `https://sofexpo.org/` is the language gate.
- The venue is a single-level hall: step-free entrance, aisles of 3 m and more, 350-seat cafés,
  free parking.
